## Problem and result

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link the related issue; use `Fixes #...` only when the PR fully resolves it.

## Validation

List commands/manual checks actually run, results, and platform skips. For UI changes, include screenshots with synthetic paths.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and behavior changes are documented.
- [ ] Relevant test scripts pass; code/build changes also pass Maven packaging.
- [ ] CLI/static reports stay read-only; review actions preserve keeper and Trash protections.
- [ ] No secrets, private paths, session URLs, build outputs, or unrelated edits are included.
